# univaBio Backend

FastAPI + SQLite backend for the doctor–patient follow-up assistant.

A consultation **session** stores the conversation **transcript** and an embedded
**clinical report** generated by **Google AI Studio (Gemini)** via the
`google-genai` SDK. Speech-to-text runs locally with **Whisper**: a doctor
records or uploads audio, and a background task transcribes it then generates the report.

## Roles
- **super_admin** — credentials from env (`SUPER_ADMIN_USERNAME`, `SUPER_ADMIN_PASS`); creates doctor profiles.
- **doctor** — logs in with `username` + password; owns many patients.
- **patient** — **no login**. Identified only by `phone` (patient id), which they
  enter to view their own record and history; belongs to exactly one doctor.

## Data model (3 tables)
- `doctor` 1 — * `patient` (patient has one doctor)
- `patient` 1 — * `session` (session belongs to one patient)
- `session` holds the transcript + the clinical report as a single Markdown string
  (`report_markdown`), plus `report_status` (`pending_key` | `generated` | `error`)
  and `report_error`. The report is generated by the LLM and rendered as Markdown in the UI.

## Setup

```bash
cd Backend
python -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate          # Windows: venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements.txt

cp .env.example .env              # then edit .env
```

In `.env`, set at minimum:
- `JWT_SECRET_KEY` — a long random string
- `SUPER_ADMIN_USERNAME`, `SUPER_ADMIN_PASS`
- `GEMINI_API_KEY` — free key from https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey
  (without it, sessions still save the transcript with `report_status = "pending_key"`)

## Run

```bash
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
```

- Interactive API docs: http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs
- Health check: http://127.0.0.1:8000/health

Optionally seed demo data (doctor `drsmith` / patient `+15550001111`):

```bash
python seed.py
```

## Key endpoints
| Method | Path | Auth | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/auth/login` | – | Login for super_admin / doctor, returns JWT |
| POST | `/admin/doctors` | super_admin | Create a doctor profile |
| GET | `/admin/doctors` | super_admin | List doctors |
| GET | `/doctors/me` | doctor | Doctor profile |
| GET | `/doctors/me/patients` | doctor | Dashboard roster (session counts, last visit) |
| POST | `/patients` | doctor | Create a patient (by phone) |
| GET | `/patients/{phone}` | owner doctor / by phone (no login) | Patient details |
| PATCH | `/patients/{phone}` | owner doctor | Update patient |
| GET | `/patients/{phone}/history` | owner doctor / by phone (no login) | All sessions + reports, newest first |
| POST | `/patients/{phone}/sessions` | owner doctor | Add transcript → generates clinical report |
| GET | `/sessions/{id}` | owner doctor / by phone (no login) | Session with report |
| POST | `/sessions/{id}/regenerate-report` | owner doctor | Re-run the LLM on the stored transcript |

## Typical flow
1. Super admin logs in and creates a doctor.
2. Doctor logs in, creates patients (phone = identifier).
3. After a visit, doctor POSTs the transcript to `/patients/{phone}/sessions`;
   the backend returns the structured clinical report.
4. On follow-up, the doctor opens `/patients/{phone}/history` for the full timeline;
   the patient views the same history by entering their phone (no login) at
   `/patients/{phone}/history`.

## Switching LLM provider
The provider is pluggable via `LLM_PROVIDER`. The default (and only built-in)
provider is Gemini, configured with `GEMINI_API_KEY`/`GEMINI_MODEL`. To use
another vendor, add a new provider class in `app/llm/` implementing the
`LLMProvider` interface and register it in the `get_provider()` factory.
